177:t_1:489.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Thank you. Now, let me introduce the members of $$フラタニティ$$.」

177:t_1:490.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Yes, yes! Let this $$ノノ$$ go first...」

177:t_1:492.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「I'm $$ニコラス・バセロン$$. Please call me $$ニコラ$$.」

177:t_1:493.en:
$$カシオ$$
「I'm $$カシオ・タカシロウ$$. You can leave $$バスターマシン$$ maintenance to me.」

177:t_1:494.en:
$$チコ$$
「I'm $$チコ・サイエンス$$. It's nice to meet you.」

177:t_1:495.en:
$$ラルク$$
「I'm $$ラルク・メルク・マール$$.」

177:t_1:496.en:
$$チコ$$
「Introduce yourself properly, Princess. You're the ace with the highest kill count of all the $$トップレス$$.」

177:t_1:497.en:
$$ラルク$$
「We don't need to talk about that.」

177:t_1:498.en:
$$ノノ$$
「You're amazing, Big Sis! You really are the strongest and the best!」

177:t_1:499.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Enough already. Hurry up and introduce yourself.」

177:t_1:500.en:
$$ノノ$$
「I'm $$ノノ$$! I'll be joining you starting today!」

177:t_1:501.en:
$$ノノ$$
「I'm single and in my prime! A maiden with dreams! I'm still a $$フラタニティ$$ trainee, but I'll do my best with effort and guts!」

177:t_1:504.en:
$$ノノ$$
「...It looks like that fell flat.」

177:t_1:505.en:
$$チコ$$
「She's an android. Maybe that's why she's a little different from us.」

177:t_1:507.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Hehe... I'm embarrassed to admit it.」

177:t_1:508.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「I can hardly believe it. The softness and sheen of her skin look just like a human's.」

177:t_1:509.en:
$$ノノ$$
「P-please don't stare so much. You'll make me blush...」

177:t_1:510.en:
$$ラルク$$
「I don't know how it works here, but androids have certain rights in our world.」

177:t_1:511.en:
$$ラルク$$
「I won't let you lay a hand on her.」

177:t_1:512.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Big Sis...! You stood up for $$ノノ$$!」

177:t_1:513.en:
$$ラルク$$
「I just hate the way lecherous men stare.」

177:t_1:514.en:
$$チコ$$
「That's our Princess. Being the ace brought you attention from men all over the world.」

177:t_1:516.en:
$$アムロ$$
「It seems you have quite a distinctive group of members.」

177:t_1:517.en:
$$ノノ$$
「You could call us the ultimate team! We're $$フラタニティ$$, united by unbreakable bonds!」

177:t_1:518.en:
$$ラルク$$
「You're still a trainee, though, $$ノノ$$.」

177:t_1:520.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「That makes us part of your team now. We look forward to working with you.」

177:t_1:521.en:
$$カレン$$
「Can I ask you something? Your robots are called $$バスターマシン$$s too, right?」

177:t_1:522.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「You also want to know how we're connected to that $$ガンバスター$$, don't you?」

177:t_1:524.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「We've already heard about it. This may disappoint you, but it seems to have no connection to us.」

177:t_1:525.en:
$$カシオ$$
「From what we've heard, that $$ガンバスター$$ seems to have been built with different technology from our $$バスターマシン$$s.」

177:t_1:526.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「But one particular person is very interested in its pilot, Miss $$ノリコ$$.」

177:t_1:527.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Because! Her name sounds like $$ノノリリ$$'s!」

177:t_1:529.en:
$$ノノ$$
「She's the space pilot $$ノノ$$ admires. She's so beautiful, so wonderful, and so strong...」

177:t_1:530.en:
$$ノノ$$
「And I hear she had an incredible figure.」

177:t_1:531.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「I'm sorry to shatter your dreams, but the $$ノリコ$$ we know isn't exactly...」

177:t_1:533.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「A-anyway...! You should meet $$ノリコ$$ sometime.」

177:t_1:535.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Unfortunately, we don't know where she is, either.」

177:t_1:536.en:
$$カレン$$
「But knowing her, she's probably fighting $$サイデリアル$$ somewhere.」

177:t_1:537.en:
$$ノノ$$
「I understand. $$ノノ$$ will keep giving life her all, looking forward to the day she meets $$ノリコ$$.」

177:t_1:538.en:
$$ニコラ$$
($$蒼の地球$$... the $$新地球皇国$$... $$サイデリアル$$...)

177:t_1:539.en:
$$ニコラ$$
(I'll put in whatever effort I need to there. But with this unit, I'll get information on parallel-world $$宇宙怪獣$$ and $$バスターマシン$$s...)

177:t_1:541.en:
$n
「...The forces to fight $$サイデリアル$$ are coming together.」

177:t_1:542.en:
$$スズネ$$
「With this much strength, surely we can capture $$ラース・バビロン$$...」

177:t_1:543.en:
$$ランド$$
「...That's some good spirit. Looks like I can expect a lot from you.」

177:t_1:545.en:
$$ランド$$
「I'm $$ランド・トラビス$$, the wandering repairman from $$ビーター・サービス$$. You might know me better as $$ザ・ヒート$$.」

177:t_1:546.en:
$$ランド$$
「Maybe I should introduce myself to you as the $$傷だらけの獅子$$'s $$リアクター$$.」

177:t_1:547.en:
$n
「...He's a $$スフィア・リアクター$$, too...」

177:t_1:548.en:
$$ランド$$
「$$アルト$$ and the others filled me in. You're the $$いがみ合う双子$$' $$リアクター$$, huh?」

177:t_1:550.en:
$$ランド$$
「Well, we're both $$リアクター$$s. I kinda knew the moment we met.」

177:t_1:551.en:
$$ランド$$
「I'm counting on you from now on, $n!」

177:t_1:554.en:
$$メール$$
「Ahaha! It looks like Darling's $$ヒートスマイル$$ shot right through your heart.」

177:t_1:556.en:
$$メール$$
「I'm $$メール・ビーター$$. I handle sales and accounting for $$ビーター・サービス$$...」

177:t_1:559.en:
$$メール$$
「Oh, I'm used to people calling us Beauty and the Beast.」

177:t_1:561.en:
$$ランド$$
「It's a long story, so I'll explain it as we go.」

177:t_1:562.en:
$$ランド$$
「Well... You're the guy $$アドヴェント#pilot$$ had his eye on. I'm expecting great things, $n.」

177:t_1:563.en:
$n
「You fought alongside $$アドヴェント#pilot$$ on $$翠の地球$$ too, $$ランド$$...」

177:t_1:564.en:
$$ランド$$
「I heard what happened to him. I never thought he'd die...」

177:t_1:566.en:
$$ランド$$
「He told me you'd save us.」

177:t_1:567.en:
$n
「$$アドヴェント#pilot$$ risked his life to save me. I want to repay him.」

177:t_1:568.en:
$n
「No... It isn't just $$アドヴェント#pilot$$. I want to fight for everyone who helped me stay alive.」
